title: Environmental groups sue Trump's EPA over repeal of landmark climate finding
text: The endangerment findings [are] based on decades of scientific consensus that climate change is real. Early on Thursday, 18 young people, aged 1 to 22, from across the US filed a separate petition challenging the rescission of the endangerment finding. They were represented by non-profit legal organizations Our Children's Trust – which scored a historic win in a constitutional climate lawsuit in Montana in 2023 – and Public Justice. "The EPA's reversal of the endangerment finding violates my first amendment right to practice my faith and my fifth amendment rights to life and liberty," said Elena Venner, the lead petitioner.
